data.label: Password reset
data.description: Someone asked for a link to set a new password for your user.
data.subject: Set a new password for {{brand}}
data.body:
Hello {{name}},

Someone asked for a link to set a new password for your user on {{brand}}. The request came from the IP address {{ip}}.

To set a new password, open this link. It works one time only, for {{minutes}} minutes:
{{resetUrl}}

A new password does not turn off your authenticator app.

If you did not ask for this link, you need not do anything. Your password does not change.
data.originalBody:
Hello {{name}},

Someone asked for a link to set a new password for your user on {{brand}}. The request came from the IP address {{ip}}.

To set a new password, open this link. It works one time only, for {{minutes}} minutes:
{{resetUrl}}

A new password does not turn off your authenticator app.

If you did not ask for this link, you need not do anything. Your password does not change.
